CustomField.description: Calculates the duration, in hours, between "Downtime Start" and "Downtime End".
CustomField.formula: IF( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Downtime_Start__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Downtime_End__c)) ), (Downtime_End__c - Downtime_Start__c) * 24, NULL )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: How many hours (including non-business hours) the equipment was unavailable for.
CustomField.label: Downtime (Calendar Hours)
